failures_and_recovery: Open URL and screen lock first required a fresh observation; Muse observed before retrying.
One click lacked the required package argument and was rejected by the CLI before dispatch; corrected argument succeeded.
First APK download stalled for about 81 seconds; a new normal browser request completed in about 6 seconds. Root cause not established.

Install interrupted the lease. Muse checked service status, waited, acquired a new lease and verified code78 before continuing; no re-pairing. Root cause of the connection change not independently established.
One draft click used an old snapshot; a fresh snapshot resolved it without repeating an unknown write.
evidence: Actual original Muse chat and its downloaded structured receipt were reviewed; raw steps, identity fields, screenshots and private drafts remain outside the public repository.
limits: One 60-second screen-off wake is not a multi-day background result.
One 96 KiB transfer does not establish fast bulk-media transport; earlier slow and retried video downloads remain recorded.
The original business task was performed on code77; this round checked its saved outputs after the upgrade.
No new notification-access grant, job application, message sending, network change, data clearing or pairing was performed.
